node.statement: For lem-residual-upper set b_j=alpha_j^+ and p_j=p_j for indices j notin A, set c_k=alpha_k^- and r_k=p_k for all negative coefficients, and set m=sum_{j notin A}alpha_j^+-sum_k alpha_k^-=1-sigma_a>0 by node 1.3. The displayed formula for q is exactly (sum b_j p_j - sum c_k r_k)/m. Node 1.1 gives ||x-r_k||_1<=2+4*delta for all x in C, so D_k=2+4*delta is admissible; since sum_k c_k=nu_v, lem-residual-upper yields the asserted bound.
